annotation.description: In the first scene, there is a walkman on the green grass. It is black with black cable and orange over ear headphones. An older man with white a bit longer hair and a white big beard approaches the walkman and picks it up. He holds a pipe  in his mouth and then in its hand hand. He wards brown leather shoes, grey pants, darker brown long short and a blue vest. He walks the the back of a graden with house in the background and pink hydrangea.
